Then nigrosine powder (Sigma-Aldrich) was added as the black dye at a mass fraction of 2 wt% relative to the PDMS prepolymer. Finally, the well-dispersed mixture was cast onto the back surface of the printed film and cured at 80 °C for 2 h, yielding a smooth, flat and uniform black PDMS background.
